screenshots.name: wh-dashboard-overview
screenshots.description: Full warehouse dashboard showing alert banner, KPI strip with non-zero values, quick actions with badge, and analytics sections
screenshots.desiredState: Full dashboard loaded with DEMO_MODE data: alert banner visible at top, KPI cards showing non-zero values (12/3/7/14/18/9), quick action cards with pending badge, analytics sections below.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the complete dashboard overview from the top — alert banner, KPI strip and quick actions are the focal point, with analytics partially visible below

mustShow: KPI metric cards with non-zero values

screenshots.name: wh-dashboard-alerts
screenshots.description: Alert banner and KPI summary strip with six non-zero metric cards and sparkline curves
screenshots.desiredState: Alert banner visible at top with stock-out/expiry warning. KPI summary strip showing all 6 metric cards with non-zero values and sparkline trend curves on the last two cards.
screenshots.differentiator: Zoomed/scrolled to focus on the alert banner and KPI strip area — shows metric card details with non-zero values, icons, and sparkline curves

mustShow: 6 metric cards with non-zero numeric values

screenshots.name: wh-dashboard-analytics
screenshots.description: Intelligence Grid (pending transfers + expiry countdown) and Analytics Grid (sparklines + top 5 moved items)
screenshots.desiredState: Intelligence Grid visible showing 4 pending transfer rows and expiry countdown badges. Analytics Grid below with real sparkline curves and 5 top moved items with gradient progress bars.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the analytics grid area — intelligence grid, sparkline charts with real curves, and top moved items list with 5 entries

stateSetup.description: Scroll down past KPI strip and quick actions to reveal the intelligence and analytics grids

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var headings = document.querySelectorAll('h2, h3, [class*=Title]'); for (var i = 0; i < headings.length; i++) { var t = headings[i].textContent.toLowerCase(); if (t.indexOf('intelligence') !== -1 || t.indexOf('pending') !== -1 || t.indexOf('analytics') !== -1) { headings[i].scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant',block:'start'}); return 'scrolled to: ' + headings[i].textContent; } } var grids = document.querySelectorAll('.mantine-SimpleGrid-root'); if (grids.length >= 2) { grids[1].scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant',block:'start'}); return 'scrolled to grid'; } window.scrollTo(0, 600); return 'fallback scroll'; })()

mustShow: Top 5 moved items with progress bars

screenshots.name: wh-dashboard-activity
screenshots.description: Recent activity timeline with 7 diverse color-coded events: receipts (green), transfers (blue), adjustment (orange), expiry (red), request (cyan)
screenshots.desiredState: Recent activity timeline visible showing 7 diverse warehouse events. Multiple event types visible: receipts (green), transfers (blue), adjustment (orange), expiry (red), request (cyan). Each event has icon, title, description, timestamp, and type badge.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the activity timeline section at the bottom — vertical list of diverse, color-coded time-stamped events, not the analytics charts above

stateSetup.description: Scroll to bottom of dashboard to reveal the recent activity timeline

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var headings = document.querySelectorAll('h2, h3, [class*=Title]'); for (var i = 0; i < headings.length; i++) { var t = headings[i].textContent.toLowerCase(); if (t.indexOf('activity') !== -1 || t.indexOf('recent') !== -1) { headings[i].scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant',block:'start'}); return 'scrolled to: ' + headings[i].textContent; } } var timeline = document.querySelector('.mantine-Timeline-root'); if (timeline) { timeline.scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant',block:'start'}); return 'scrolled to timeline'; } window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight); return 'scrolled to bottom'; })()

mustShow: Multiple event type colors (green, blue, orange, red, cyan)
